results.cell: Phone image → pinch → fullscreen → landscape → scroll
results.expected: I can zoom, fill the screen, rotate and keep reading at the same relative place.
results.observed: Touch pinch 1.69×; fullscreen native; scroll ratio 0.400 → 0.400 on rotation; drag continued scrolling.
results.label: real-build

results.cell: Appearance and geometry at six scheme/viewport combinations
results.expected: The study and image controls stay readable without page overflow in light and dark.
results.observed: All 6 viewport/scheme pairs: 10 proposals, 20 proposal views, no horizontal page overflow; reader controls visible and vertically scrollable.
results.label: real-build

results.cell: Fullscreen API rejects; page and image fallback
results.expected: Full screen still gives me a scrollable full-viewport reader and Escape restores the page.
results.observed: Native API deliberately rejected; CSS viewport fallback remained scrollable after rotation. First Escape exited fullscreen; second closed the reader.
results.label: real-build

results.cell: Keyboard-only opening, zoom, scroll, close and return
results.expected: I can operate the image reader with the keyboard and focus returns to the image I opened.
results.observed: Enter opened; + zoomed; PageDown scrolled; 0 fit width; Escape restored focus to the opening image.
results.label: real-build

results.cell: Revisit and switch images after zooming
results.expected: A new image opens at fit width; the correct caption and system context follow it.
results.observed: Reopening a different image reset to fit width and showed its own caption; mouse wheel zoom increased the new image scale.
results.label: real-build

results.expected: All ten proposals, baseline images and the comparison remain available.
results.observed: JavaScript off: 10 proposals, 10 comparison rows and all 25 images decoded; print PDF contains the study.
results.label: real-build

results.cell: Offline standalone file and all embedded images
results.expected: The study opens from a local file and loads every image without network access.
results.observed: Opened standalone file with browser offline; zero HTTP(S) requests; all embedded images decoded and current-state lightbox opened.
results.label: real-build

results.expected: I can read the entire study fullscreen, reach the comparison and return without losing my place.
results.observed: Whole-study fullscreen (native) reached the comparison; Escape restored document scrolling near the same position.
results.label: real-build
